notes:
ACCESS: robots.txt read first - target.com names no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web agent, sets no Crawl-delay, and disallows none of the /c/ category paths used here (its /c-prefixed rules are /cgi-bin, /cgi-local, /co-, /common, /coupons., /custom-reviews/, /cart, /config). Plain curl_cffi reached every /c/ page (winning profiles rotated chrome120/chrome124/chrome131/safari18_0/firefox133). TREE: from Target's own server-rendered taxonomy JSON embedded in each /c/-/N- page - the children[] array of node_id/name/type/number_of_children/canonical_url. Walked breadth-first from Home N-5xtvd, then in full through Bath N-5xtvc (11 children) and Home Improvement N-5xtt9 -> Bath Fixtures N-349p4 (12 children) and Hardware -> Bathroom Hardware N-1nh6y (7 children), re-querying every node until no unvisited children remained. Cross-checked against Target's own category sitemap https://www.target.com/c/sitemap_0001.xml.gz (8,099 canonical /c/ URLs): every URL recorded or reviewed here is present in it verbatim, and the sitemap was regex-scanned for bath|shower|toilet|vanit|bidet|sink|faucet|soap|towel|mirror|tub-|plumb (212 hits) with every hit resolved to one of the nodes accounted for below, so no bathroom node was missed. QTY - THE RENDERED HEADER, NOT AN API PROXY: Target PLPs are client-rendered for a normal browser, but the same URL fetched with a crawler user-agent returns the fully server-rendered page including the real results header, data-test="lp-resultsCount" -> 'N results'. Every qty in this file is that exact rendered number, read from the node's own canonical URL, and every response was validated by checking its

against the node requested (e.g. N-gbnw6 -> h1 'Bathroom Vanities', N-npn8h -> 'Undermount Bathroom Sinks', N-pjxqb -> 'Towel Rings') - 85 nodes fetched, 85 H1 matches, no fallback page. PROOF THAT THE HEADER IS THE EXACT GRID SIZE: (1) exhaustion - Undermount Bathroom Sinks header 8, page 1 renders exactly 8 distinct /p/-/A- product links; ?Nao=7 renders exactly 1 product; ?Nao=8 renders no results block at all. Wall Mounted Sinks header 12: ?Nao=11 -> exactly 1 product, ?Nao=12 -> no results block. So the last item sits at offset N-1 and N is out of range. (2) Independent second source - the storefront's own listing API, redsky.target.com/redsky_aggregations/v1/web/plp_search_v2 -> data.search.search_response.metadata.total_results (the endpoint the grid itself pages through; proven exact by boundary test on three nodes: offset=total-1 returns exactly 1 product, offset=total returns 0, for Towel Rings 38, Bidets 47 and Bathroom Hardware Sets 55). It was read for 28 of these nodes about an hour before the rendered pass and agreed to within 0-3% on every one, always slightly lower (Soap Dishes 313=313, Toothbrush Holders 276=276, Bathroom Trays 175=175, Washcloths 173=173, Bathroom Vanities 3375=3375; Shower Caddies 306 vs 311, Bath Towels 750 vs 752), which is live catalogue growth over the interval, not a methodological gap. Note redsky.target.com 403s this IP with a PerimeterX captcha on a direct call and r.jina.ai is now Cloudflare-challenged, so the API cross-check had to be routed through redsky-target-com.translate.goog, which then rate-limited; the rendered-header route needed no proxy at all and is the one recorded. Counts discriminate hugely (8 to 3,863), every parent exceeds its largest child (Bath 14,224; Bathroom Furniture 5,048 vs Bathroom Vanities 3,375; Bath Fixtures 2,458; Bathroom Sinks 288 vs Drop-In 196), and no value is a round display cap. PARENT / DUPLICATE HANDLING: no parent URL is recorded where children exist - Bath (14,224), Shower Curtains & Accessories (2,455), Towels (5,420), Bathroom Accessories (2,621), Bath Rugs & Mats (2,727), Kids' Bath (594), Bathroom Furniture (5,048), Bath Fixtures (2,458), Bathroom Hardware (751) and Bathroom Sinks (288) are all emitted as grouping rows with blank qty and blank link (rule 24, 38). Two nodes are reachable from two parents and are recorded exactly once (rule 28): Shower Curtain Rods N-jy6ys (under both Shower Curtains & Accessories and Bathroom Hardware) is recorded under Shower Curtains & Accessories, which owns its canonical slug; Shower Heads N-5xtsx (under both Bath and Bath Fixtures) is recorded under Bath Fixtures, which owns its canonical slug. Beach Towels N-5xtv6 likewise appears twice and is routed out once. EXCLUDED: the Tag-type nodes Bath Deals (N-797fm), Dorm Bath Essentials (N-5tf7g) and Bathroom Refresh & Remodel (N-5gh7a) are promotional landing pages with no catalogue children (rule 25). Bath > Kids' Bath > Potty Training (N-5xtl4) is a Baby department node (potty chairs, training pants, wipes) and is not bathroom fittings. /c/bathroom-storage-organization-home/-/N-ybjeq is a cross-department landing hub whose 17 children are every node already recorded or reviewed above (Bathroom Vanities, Medicine Cabinets, Over the Toilet Storage, Soap Dishes, Shower Caddies, Storage Baskets ...), so recording it would duplicate them wholesale. Household Essentials > Cleaning Supplies > Bathroom Cleaners' chemical children - Toilet Bowl Cleaners (N-rw396), Shower & Tub Cleaners (N-cnlxn) and the four Tag nodes under it - are consumable cleaning fluids, not bathroom accessories; only Toilet Brushes is recorded from that parent, on the strength of rule 14 naming toilet brushes explicitly. Beauty > Bath & Body and its whole subtree (body wash, bath bombs, bar soap, spa & relaxation, massagers) is personal care. Kitchen Fixtures, kitchen sinks and kitchen faucets are excluded as kitchen. NOT SOLD: Target publishes no bathtub / freestanding bath category and no shower enclosure or wet-room panel category; the closest nodes are Shower Doors (recorded) and Bathtub Faucets (recorded). It also has no standalone Toilets category - only Toilet Seats, Bidets and Toilet Replacement Parts - so rules 4 and 5 are genuinely thin here rather than skipped. || CROSS-FILE DEDUP: 4 leaf record(s) removed as already extracted in a prior category workbook. See Review sheet.
